propositions: Dependabot PR #125 proposes two dependency bumps: zizmor 1.28.0→1.29.0 and mcp 1.29.0→2.0.0, but mcp 2.0 removes the mcp.server.fastmcp module that multiple source files currently import, requiring structural migration deferred to ticket 732b

The zizmor 1.29.0 bump should be landed separately to maintain dev/CI parity, with the exact pin in pyproject.toml preserved and uv.lock regenerated via uv lock --upgrade-package rather than hand-edited
The mcp version ceiling must remain <2 to keep mcp pinned at 1.29.0, rejecting the 2.0 upgrade until the migration work in ticket 732b is completed

Landing this change requires a Gerrit commit with rebar-ticket trailer, passing lint/typecheck/tests locally and CI gates, then closing PR #125 with a comment linking the merged commit and pointing the mcp half to ticket 732b
The change was successfully merged as Gerrit 1483 (commit 4bce6a3cca435f9d52dbe2e1969dd08cab605e29) with all acceptance criteria verified and PR #125 closed
